Son Jarocho Collective

An original piano composition exploring melancholy and resolution.

Role: Musician Timeline: May 2025 - August 2026 Instruments: Jarana, Requinto, Violin
Music Original Classical

Overview

This piece was composed during a late-night session, channeling influences from Chopin and contemporary film scores. It represents a fusion of classical structure with modern harmonic language.

Composition Details

  • Key: E Minor
  • Tempo: 72 BPM
  • Time Signature: 4/4
  • Instruments: Solo Piano

Lyrics

Program Notes

The piece is meant to evoke a quiet nocturnal atmosphere, balancing melancholy with a sense of gentle resolution.

Creative Process

The composition began with a simple melodic motif that evolved through multiple variations. The recording was done using a condenser microphone setup in a home studio environment.

Gallery & Scores

Reflections

Music provides an outlet for emotional expression that complements my technical work. The discipline required for mastering an instrument parallels the iterative process of engineering design.
